en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his companions, having delivered with it by Zurara who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! The fat which throws out the likes of it from the ailments, which fat is it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is fat of the cow, and O Zurara, no one has asked me about it before you’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn ‘Abd Allah from certain persons of his people (and) brought by Zurarah who has said the following: “I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, ‘Al-Shahmah (the fat) that expels the same amount of illness, which shahmah is it?’
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is shahmah of al-Baqar (cow) and no one before you has asked me about it.’”
